The four trusted browser suites completed readonly copy, Cut rejection, caret
collapse, Paste rejection and the final paste/completion checks, as well as all
earlier Prompt, resize and clipboard actions. Safari's separate original full
journey also passed. The retained framework failures are distinct: Chrome and
Firefox lost an injected composing range; Safari passed Prompt composition and
numeric scenarios but lost the composing range during synthetic resize; Edge
timed out during WebDriver navigation after 300 seconds and produced no
framework assertion report. None establishes OS IME acceptance.

Android's emulator booted and installed the built APK. The failure at
`catalog_journey_test.dart:143:9` is the `Copied` text assertion, not setup.
iOS's first VM log-history query captured zero bytes before its 15-second
limit, and cleanup could not verify host process-group membership. The report
does not preserve whether the underlying `ps` command timed out or exited
nonzero. No iOS Dart driver result was observed for this candidate.

The native bridge probe verified occupied AtkSockets, natural missing-parent
repair, real inverse getters, repeated-call no-op, preservation of a constructed
existing parent and preservation of a replacement through view destruction.
All weak-reference finalization checks passed. Its original `report.json`
contains runtime stdout diagnostics followed by one JSON document; it is **not
a pure JSON file**. The archive retains the complete original and a separately
labelled extraction with its source hash. Later explicit `--report` output is a
separate packaging fix.

In the real Catalog, Space changed the focused Theme control from system to
light. All six actual parent edges reached the same-process frame and had
verified inverse child getters. A fresh Where Am I handler nevertheless
generated the old system name after measured silence. Thinking reached its
disclosure, whose native expanded/expandable/enabled states were absent. Search
issued one Tab, then hit the existing eight-second inspection limit before a
query or selection was entered. The [Linux SDK boundary report](../../docs/beautiful-ui/quality_evidence/2026-09-04-linux-sdk-accessibility-boundaries.md)
records the matching source contracts, exact timestamps and PCM checks.

Narrator again lacked a default WASAPI render endpoint (`0x80070490`) despite
native accessibility and ordinary keyboard response. No CI runs were retried
or cancelled. Full application AT acceptance, human speech review, physical
device acceptance and OS IME acceptance remain unestablished.
